name: Color

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Four logical channels in 0..255. Alpha defaults to opaque for rgb; this is a value, not a capability.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Color.rgb/rgba/hex/parseHex; red/green/blue/alpha, equals, withAlpha, hash and serializers in the measured profile.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: The Color value preserves its concrete semantic identity through bindings and arguments. Arithmetic/comparison does not grant I/O authority; console is an explicit effect. Only the documented comparisons and generic constraint profiles apply. A TypeId does not synthesize a user-defined Eq/Ord, clone or drop implementation.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: An RGBA value with checked channels and explicit Console roles.
